parent_objective: probe whether the useful M330 exact/source-diverse direction can be accepted inside an old-key gap-bounded trust region

public_gates: interpolate M328 base to M330 repaired
exact M297 and exact M270 no-regression versus M328
old 9944 margin gap remains at least 0.09
M183/M170 first replay gate versus M328
M267/M264 first replay gate versus M328
forbidden_shortcuts: do not lower the old-key floor
do not skip source-diverse protected gates
hypothesis: Interpolating from M328 base toward the M330 repaired candidate may recover useful exact/source-diverse improvement while keeping the old-key margin gap above the 0.09 diagnostic floor.
success_criteria: one or more nonzero alphas pass exact M297/M270 no-regression
one or more nonzero alphas pass source-diverse protected gates
one or more nonzero alphas retain old-key margin_gap >= 0.09
selected alpha passes M183/M170 and M267/M264 first replay gates
failure_criteria: no nonzero alpha passes exact objectives
no nonzero alpha passes source-diverse protected gates
no nonzero alpha retains old-key margin gap floor
first replay gate fails for the selected alpha

commands.name: m332_interpolation
commands.command: PYTHONPATH=src python -m autodrift.checkpoint_interpolation --base-checkpoint runs/m327_exact_repair_from_raw_s40_seed10097/candidate_checkpoint.pt --target-checkpoint runs/m330_exact_repair_from_raw_s40_seed10098/candidate_checkpoint.pt --alphas 0,0.2,0.35,0.45,0.5,0.55,0.6,0.75,1.0 --base-label m328_base --target-label m330_repaired --label-prefix m332 --run-dir runs/m332_m328_to_m330_gap_bounded_interpolation

commands.name: m332_exact_line_search
commands.command: Evaluate exact M297/M270 over the interpolation alpha grid versus M328 base.

commands.name: m332_old_key_sweep
commands.command: Run 9944 diagnostic over interpolation checkpoints and select the largest alpha with margin_gap >= 0.09.

commands.name: m332_source_diverse_and_first_replay
commands.command: Run source-diverse protected gate plus M183/M170 and M267/M264 first replay gates for the selected alpha.

decision_rule: M332 admits a full public gate because alpha 0.45 passes exact objectives, source-diverse protected gates, old-key margin-gap floor, and M183/M170 plus M267/M264 first replay gates. M332 itself does not promote.
